name: 2N2222
description: Classic general-purpose NPN, a notch beefier than the 2N3904 (up to ~600-800mA). The original metal-can TO-18 part is pinout-reversed from the modern TO-92 PN2222A; this entry covers the common TO-92 plastic version, which is E-B-C.

TO-92.notes: TO-92 (PN2222A), flat face toward you: E-B-C. The metal-can TO-18 2N2222 is E-B-C too but in a different physical arrangement; check the package.

extra.Vbe(on): 1.2V (max) @ Ic=150mA, Ib=15mA (datasheet's VBE(sat), from the onsemi P2N2222A variant sheet)

typical_application: Switching relays and small loads, driving the base of a bigger transistor, general gain. Handles more collector current than the 2N3904.
gotchas: pinout is MANUFACTURER-DEPENDENT. the common TO-92 convention (and the metal-can 2N2222A, TO-18) is E-B-C, but onsemi's P2N2222A is mirrored to C-B-E -- collector and emitter swapped. always check the specific part number against its own datasheet; a mismatch swaps collector and emitter.
TO-92 plastic (PN2222A) is E-B-C; do not assume metal-can ordering
the metal-can TO-18 original has the leads in a triangle, easy to misread
add a flyback diode across inductive loads (relays, motors)

variants.note: mirror of the common E-B-C pinout: collector and emitter swapped. verified against the onsemi P2N2222A package drawing.
